name: r4tsk
description: Skript language support: syntax highlighting, hover call-signature preview, autocomplete, diagnostics, go-to-definition and a bundled dark theme.

r4tsk.diagnostics.enable.description: Enable diagnostics for undefined functions, argument mismatches and duplicate definitions.

r4tsk.docsPath.description: Absolute path to a docs.json file (from https://github.com/SkriptLang/skript-docs) to use instead of the bundled one/auto-download, e.g. one you generated/downloaded for your exact Skript version. Leave empty to use auto-download. Applies live, no reload needed - or run "r4tsk: Set Core Docs File..." to pick one with a file browser instead of typing a path.

r4tsk.additionalDocsPaths.description: Absolute paths to additional docs.json files to merge in alongside the core Skript docs - e.g. for addons like SkBee or Skript-GUI. Generate one by running a Skript server with the addon installed and executing '/sk gen-docs' (its docs.json uses the same schema as core Skript's, since the generator captures every installed addon's syntax). Applies live, no reload needed - or run "r4tsk: Manage Addon Docs Files..." to add/remove entries with a file browser instead of editing this list by hand.

r4tsk.autoDownloadDocs.description: Automatically download (and cache) a docs.json matching your configured Skript version from https://github.com/SkriptLang/skript-docs. Disable to always use the bundled snapshot instead. Ignored if r4tsk.docsPath is set.

r4tsk.crossVersionSuggestions.description: In the background, download a small set of docs.json snapshots (one per supported Skript minor version) so hover/diagnostics can suggest 'you might be thinking of X from Skript Y' when something isn't found in your configured version. Uses a few extra MB of one-time downloads/cache. Ignored if r4tsk.docsPath is set.

r4tsk.annotationColors.param.background.description: Background color for @param tags (leave empty for none).

r4tsk.annotationColors.return.background.description: Background color for @return/@returns tags (leave empty for none).

r4tsk.annotationColors.deprecated.backgr.description: Background color for @deprecated tags (leave empty for none).

r4tsk.annotationColors.todo.background.description: Background color for TODO annotations (leave empty for none).

r4tsk.annotationColors.warn.background.description: Background color for WARN annotations (leave empty for none).

r4tsk.annotationColors.important.foregro.description: Foreground color for !/important annotations (applies to the rest of the line too).

r4tsk.annotationColors.important.backgro.description: Background color for !/important annotations (leave empty for none).

r4tsk.customPatterns.description: Custom regex patterns to color anywhere in a .sk file - e.g. an ASCII-art banner comment at the top of your scripts. Matches across the whole document (not just comments), so multi-line patterns work too. Run "r4tsk: Configure Custom Colored Patterns" to edit this in Settings.

pattern.description: JavaScript regular expression to match. The 'g' flag is always applied automatically; use the multiline flag 'm' in "flags" if your pattern uses ^/$ per-line.

flags.description: Optional extra regex flags, e.g. 'm' (multiline) or 'i' (case-insensitive).
